overview_description.description:
Foxpass increases your organization's server and network security by ensuring employee accounts have access only to what they need.

Their cloud-hosted LDAP, RADIUS, and server access control systems help you bring best practices to your infrastructure. And they're backed by your existing Google Apps or Office 365 accounts.

product.name: Cloud RADIUS Server
product.description: A cloud-hosted RADIUS server providing authentication, authorization, and accounting services for network access control.

product.name: Cloud LDAP Server
product.description: A cloud-hosted LDAP server that centralizes directory and authentication data for user and device management.

product.name: SSH Key Management
product.description: A system to manage SSH keys for secure access to servers, including key rotation and policy enforcement.

product.name: 802.1X Wi-Fi Authentication
product.description: An authentication framework using 802.1X and RADIUS to secure Wi-Fi access with per-user credentials and certificate-based methods.

product.name: Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) Endpoint
product.description: A protocol endpoint that automates the issuance and management of PKI certificates for network devices.

product.name: RadSec (RADIUS over TLS)
product.description: A protocol that secures RADIUS communication by transmitting data over TLS-encrypted channels.
